blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The trough, or extension, of a low-pressure area (LPA) outside the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) will bring cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms over Eastern Visayas and Bohol on Tuesday, September 22.
